ucs.title: [LLM] Octo Tempest federated-trust backdoor (rogue IdP / domain federation tamper)
ucs.description: Hunts the signature Scattered Spider / Octo Tempest persistence move: after help-desk social-engineering of a Global Admin, the actor adds an unverified domain or flips a domain to federated auth and registers a rogue token-signing IdP so they can mint forged SAML tokens for any user. Domain-federation modification is rare in steady-state tenants, making this an alerting-grade signal for UNC3944.
ucs.splunk:
index=azure (sourcetype="azure:aad:audit" OR sourcetype="azure:monitor:aad")
| eval op=lower('operationName')
| search op IN ("set domain authentication","set federation settings on domain","add unverified domain","add domain","set dirsyncenabled flag")
| stats count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(op) as operations values(targetResources{}.displayName) as targetDomain by initiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName, initiatedBy.user.ipAddress
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
| sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
let FederationActions = dynamic(["Set domain authentication","Set federation settings on domain","Add unverified domain","Add domain","Set DirSyncEnabled flag","Update domain"]);
CloudAppEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where Application in~ ("Office 365","Microsoft Entra ID","Azure Active Directory")
| where ActionType in~ (FederationActions)
| extend ActorIp = tostring(parse_json(RawEventData).ActorIpAddress)
| project Timestamp, ActionType, Actor = AccountDisplayName, AccountId, ActorIp, IPAddress, CountryCode, ISP, ObjectName, IsAdminOperation, RawEventData
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let FederationOps = dynamic(["Set domain authentication","Set federation settings on domain","Add unverified domain","Add domain","Update domain","Set DirSyncEnabled flag"]);
AuditLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where OperationName in~ (FederationOps)
| where Result =~ "success"
| extend Actor = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName), ActorIp = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.ipAddress)
| mv-expand TargetResources
| extend TargetDomain = tostring(TargetResources.displayName)
| project TimeGenerated, OperationName, Actor, ActorIp, TargetDomain, Result, CorrelationId
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:azure.activeDirectory @evt.name:("Set domain authentication" OR "Set federation settings on domain" OR "Add unverified domain" OR "Add domain" OR "Set DirSyncEnabled flag")
ucs.rationale: Federated-domain / token-signing-IdP tampering (AADInternals-style) is a documented Octo Tempest persistence technique that legitimate admins almost never perform once a tenant is configured. Tying it to admin-account context and a foreign actor IP separates UNC3944 backdooring from random APT activity that would more typically pivot through OAuth grants or service principals.

ucs.title: [LLM] Scattered Spider RMM + tunneling tradecraft (first-seen AnyDesk/Splashtop/ngrok from user-writable path)
ucs.description: Hunts UNC3944's hands-on-keyboard remote-access pattern: after socially-engineered logon they side-load commodity RMM agents (AnyDesk, Splashtop, ScreenConnect, Pulseway, FleetDeck, Level, RustDesk) and ngrok/rclone tunnels from Downloads/Temp/ProgramData to retain access and exfiltrate. The org-baseline anti-join flags the binary the first time it appears, which is what makes it actor-specific rather than IT's sanctioned RMM.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as process values(Processes.process_path) as path from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name IN ("anydesk.exe","teamviewer.exe","splashtop*.exe","screenconnect*.exe","pulseway*.exe","fleetdeck*.exe","rustdesk.exe","level.exe","ngrok.exe","rclone.exe","ateraagent.exe","syncro*.exe")) (Processes.process_path="*\\Users\\*" OR Processes.process_path="*\\Temp\\*" OR Processes.process_path="*\\Downloads\\*" OR Processes.process_path="*\\ProgramData\\*") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.parent_process_name
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
| sort - firstTime
ucs.kql:
let RMM = dynamic(["anydesk.exe","teamviewer.exe","splashtopstreamer.exe","sra_dispatch.exe","screenconnect.clientservice.exe","screenconnect.windowsclient.exe","pulseway.exe","fleetdeck_agent.exe","rustdesk.exe","level.exe","ngrok.exe","rclone.exe","ateraagent.exe"]);
let Baseline = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp between (ago(30d) .. ago(1d))
    | where FileName in~ (RMM)
    | summarize by FileName;
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(1d)
| where FileName in~ (RMM)
| where FolderPath has_any (@"\Users\", @"\Temp\", @"\Downloads\", @"\ProgramData\", @"\AppData\")
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where AccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
| join kind=leftanti Baseline on FileName    // org first-seen for this RMM/tunnel binary
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine, SHA256, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessFolderPath
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let RMM = dynamic(["anydesk.exe","teamviewer.exe","splashtopstreamer.exe","screenconnect.clientservice.exe","screenconnect.windowsclient.exe","pulseway.exe","fleetdeck_agent.exe","rustdesk.exe","level.exe","ngrok.exe","rclone.exe","ateraagent.exe"]);
let Baseline = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where TimeGenerated between (ago(30d) .. ago(1d))
    | where FileName in~ (RMM)
    | summarize by FileName;
DeviceProcessEvents
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where FileName in~ (RMM)
| where FolderPath has_any (@"\Users\", @"\Temp\", @"\Downloads\", @"\ProgramData\", @"\AppData\")
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| join kind=leftanti Baseline on FileName
| project TimeGenerated, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine, SHA256, InitiatingProcessFileName
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Scattered Spider Commodity RMM / Tunneling Tool Execution From User-Writable Path
id: 7f1c9d2a-4b6e-49a1-9c3f-2e8a1d6b0f44
status: experimental
description: Detects execution of commodity RMM agents and tunneling utilities favored by UNC3944 / Octo Tempest from Downloads, Temp, ProgramData or AppData paths.
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_img:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\anydesk.exe'
      - '\teamviewer.exe'
      - '\splashtopstreamer.exe'
      - '\screenconnect.clientservice.exe'
      - '\screenconnect.windowsclient.exe'
      - '\pulseway.exe'
      - '\fleetdeck_agent.exe'
      - '\rustdesk.exe'
      - '\level.exe'
      - '\ngrok.exe'
      - '\rclone.exe'
      - '\ateraagent.exe'
  selection_path:
    Image|contains:
      - '\Users\'
      - '\Temp\'
      - '\Downloads\'
      - '\ProgramData\'
      - '\AppData\'
  condition: selection_img and selection_path
falsepositives:
  - Sanctioned IT remote-support tooling launched from a portable/user path
level: high
tags:
  - attack.command_and_control
  - attack.t1219.002
  - attack.t1572
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @Image:(*\AnyDesk.exe OR *\anydesk.exe OR *\TeamViewer.exe OR *\teamviewer.exe OR *\SplashtopStreamer.exe OR *\splashtopstreamer.exe OR *\ScreenConnect.ClientService.exe OR *\Pulseway.exe OR *\pulseway.exe OR *\rustdesk.exe OR *\RustDesk.exe OR *\ngrok.exe OR *\rclone.exe OR *\AteraAgent.exe) @Image:(*\Users\* OR *\Temp\* OR *\Downloads\* OR *\ProgramData\* OR *\AppData\*)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ImageFileName=/\\(anydesk|teamviewer|splashtopstreamer|screenconnect\.(clientservice|windowsclient)|pulseway|fleetdeck_agent|rustdesk|level|ngrok|rclone|ateraagent)\.exe$/i
| regex("\\\\(Users|Temp|Downloads|ProgramData|AppData)\\\\", field=ImageFileName)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ImageFileName, CommandLine, UserName], function=count())
ucs.rationale: UNC3944 is uniquely reliant on legitimate, signed RMM agents (rather than custom implants) plus ngrok/rclone, dropped to user-writable paths after socially-engineered access. The org first-seen anti-join suppresses the sanctioned RMM your IT team already runs and surfaces the actor's freshly side-loaded copy, which is the distinguishing behavior CrowdStrike and MSTIC both call out for this crew.

_sentinel_field_issues.message: `TimeGenerated` is not a column of DeviceProcessEvents; it does exist on DeviceInfo, IdentityInfo, DeviceTvmSoftwareVulnerabilities, SigninLogs, AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs, AADServicePrincipalSignInLogs, AADManagedIdentitySignInLogs, AuditLogs, SecurityEvent, WindowsEvent, Event, Syslog, OfficeActivity, AzureActivity, AzureDiagnostics, AppServiceHTTPLogs, AKSAudit, CommonSecurityLog, DnsEvents, W3CIISLog, ThreatIntelligenceIndicator, SecurityAlert, SecurityIncident, Heartbeat, Update, ImProcessCreate, ImNetworkSession, ImAuthentication, ImWebSession, ImFileEvent, ImDnsActivity, ImRegistryEvent, ASCDeviceEvents.
